note: Every binary downloaded from the package-inputs release for the channel packages, the source that built it, and how that was established. rebuilt-identical means a rebuild from the named sources reproduced the exact bytes; unverified names the likeliest published source by file name only. tools/check-m4-packages.py refuses any package whose downloaded binary lacks a rebuilt-identical join, with no override in CI.
